$comment: The ONE list of pages the nightly revalidates. Read by app/api/revalidate/route.ts (the allowlist) and by .github/workflows/seed.yml (the request body). A path with a [segment] is a route pattern and revalidates every page it matches: /counties/[id] is all 47 counties. __tests__/api/revalidateManifest.test.ts fails if a server-rendered data page is missing from this list.
